title: Googly Packet
description: One newline-delimited JSON message exchanged between the host (PC) and the client (phone). Field names and semantics are frozen to match the original app (Shared/GooglyLink.swift of rbrown101010/bluey-by-riley @ 6d84d91). All fields are optional; unset fields are omitted rather than set to null, and decoders must ignore unknown fields.

face.description: What the phone's face should show right now. Host to phone, at least 1 Hz while connected.

hello.description: Sent once by each side right after the connection is ready: the sender's device name.

volume.description: Legacy field from the original's speech-audio era. Accepted, never emitted.

command.description: A request, reply, or event. Known values: hello, face (implicit via the face field), wake, sleep, awake, asleep, realtimeToken, tool, toolResult, transcribe, transcribed, notes, caption, captionDone; legacy: testVoice, playing, done, stopSpeech.

audio.description: Base64 audio. Today: an AAC meeting-notes chunk attached to a transcribe request. Legacy: mp3 speech for the phone to play.

speech.description: Legacy field: which speech an audio packet or a playing/done event belonged to. Accepted, never emitted.

callID.description: Correlates a request with its reply (realtimeToken, tool/toolResult, transcribe/transcribed, notes). The requester mints a UUID; the replier echoes it verbatim.

tool.description: On a tool request: the tool name, e.g. look_at_screen.

text.description: Free text: tool arguments or tool output, a minted client secret, a caption, or JSON metadata (transcribe/notes).

image.description: Base64 JPEG accompanying a toolResult (the screenshot from look_at_screen).

faceState.description: What the phone should show: where the eyes look, the mood, and the voice level.

talk.description: Voice level; drives the talking bounce.
